tools.name: search_fabric_and_wallpaper
tools.description:
Search handcrafted wallpaper and fabric designs (print patterns) by independent designers on PatternShow, for home decor, interior design and sewing project inspiration. Returns designs rendered as wallpaper and fabric, with the designer, a link to the design page and, when available, links to buy the wallpaper or fabric on Spoonflower and to the Wallpaper Planner (rolls to order and cut list for the user's wall).

- query: motifs, themes or styles in a few words, e.g. 'cats', 'art deco', 'botanical', 'kids animals'. Color names also work ('sage green', 'navy'). Leave out the room or project ('bedroom', 'dress'): use it to choose product and colors instead. Leave empty to browse.
- colors: to find patterns that MATCH a photo (a dress, a sofa, a room, a wallpaper), look at the photo, extract its 2 to 5 main colors as hex values (e.g. ['#7a8b6f', '#f3ede2']) and pass them here. Results are ranked by how well their colors match.
- product: 'fabric' or 'wallpaper' to show that rendering first, 'any' otherwise.

The results are shown to the user as an image gallery when the app supports it. In your reply, briefly describe the best matches and credit their designers; share the pattern page links if the user cannot see the gallery.
